narr: Numerous heavy rains and severe thunderstorms developed all across the region during the afternoon and evening of August 7th. Numerous flash floods, mud and debris slides, and damaging winds and hail were all reported as storms moved from the central mountains onto the eastern CO plains.
ev: Flooding along Hwy 115 near Pathfinder Park.
Mudslide on Hwy 67 just north of US 50.
Flooded roads, mud slide and water into building at the pueblo nature and wildlife center.
Around 100-foot wide channel of flowing water through properties -- at least several inches deep -- created by heavy rain from thunderstorms yesterday evening.
Reports of multiple areas of flooded roadways across western and northern parts of pueblo west, included a stranded vehicle.
